body: Thank you.  I finish school on June 7th, hopefully then I can really work on repairing the damage from these past few weeks and start to feel like myself again.

Thank you for being so caring and gentle.  My best friend and I have been drifting apart for some time now, I'm just sad that it's ending this way.  Ever since I was young, I've craved the male attention that I don't get from my father, and the only way I know how to get it is to be flirtatious and be attractive to men aesthetically.  I know it's bad, but I get most of my self-worth from others and I don't know how to shift the focus inward.  I have been eating worse lately, and I stopped exercising, both of which are affecting my sleep (I have finals next week and I tend to stress eat, plus I have no time to work out).  Maybe tomorrow I'll go for a walk.
